// v0.12.0's end-to-end witness guest (#1122): a fork-built Go program that runs with real threads through
// `burroughs run`, with nothing supplied beyond the module.
//
//  1. Real parallel work: `workers` busy goroutines under GOMAXPROCS = workers, so the runtime starts several Ms,
//     each a spawned agent. Each computes a fixed hash chain over its index. The program prints the combined
//     digest, which the test recomputes with stock Go.
//  2. GC across agents: clause 3's checksummed ring (testdata/clause3/guest.go.txt, scaled the same way), mutated
//     while collections are forced, with finalizers on nodes the ring still holds. The program prints VERIFIED
//     only if every node's checksum holds and no finalizer ran.
//
// Output is written once, at the end, after every goroutine has finished. Clause 3 recorded that `print` takes
// locks while a collection may be stopping the world.
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"sync"
)

const (
	workers     = 4
	rounds      = 200000
	nodes       = 50
	collections = 8
	mutations   = 600
)

// chain is the worker's deterministic share. The test computes the same function with stock Go.
func chain(seed uint64) uint64 {
	x := seed*0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 + 1
	for i := 0; i < rounds; i++ {
		x ^= x >> 33
		x *= 0xFF51AFD7ED558CCD
		x ^= x >> 29
		x += uint64(i)
	}
	return x
}

type node struct {
	id, pay, sum uint32
	next         *node
}

func checksum(n *node) uint32 {
	var succ uint32
	if n.next != nil {
		succ = n.next.id
	}
	return n.id*2654435761 ^ n.pay*40503 ^ succ*2246822519
}

var (
	head      *node
	finalized uint32
	finMu     sync.Mutex
)

func main() {
	runtime.GOMAXPROCS(workers)

	results := make([]uint64, workers)
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for w := 0; w < workers; w++ {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func(w int) {
			defer wg.Done()
			// Not runtime.LockOSThread: on this fork a locked M that needs a new M throws "on a locked thread
			// with no template thread" (#1122's build, 2026-10-27). GOMAXPROCS = workers and busy goroutines
			// are what put the work on several Ms, each a spawned agent; the engine's live-agent gauge is the
			// evidence that it did.
			results[w] = chain(uint64(w) + 1)
		}(w)
	}

	var prev *node
	for i := 0; i < nodes; i++ {
		n := &node{id: uint32(i) + 1}
		if prev != nil {
			prev.next = n
		} else {
			head = n
		}
		runtime.SetFinalizer(n, func(*node) { finMu.Lock(); finalized++; finMu.Unlock() })
		prev = n
	}
	prev.next = head
	for n, i := head, 0; i < nodes; n, i = n.next, i+1 {
		n.sum = checksum(n)
	}
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		n := head
		for i := 0; i < mutations; i++ {
			n.pay = uint32(i)*2654435761 + 1
			n.sum = checksum(n)
			n = n.next
		}
		close(done)
	}()
	for i := 0; i < collections; i++ {
		runtime.GC()
	}
	<-done
	wg.Wait()

	seen, bad := 0, uint32(0)
	for n, i := head, 0; i < nodes; i++ {
		if n == nil || n.sum != checksum(n) {
			if n != nil {
				bad = n.id
			} else {
				bad = uint32(seen) + 1
			}
			break
		}
		seen++
		n = n.next
	}
	finMu.Lock()
	fin := finalized
	finMu.Unlock()
	verdict := "VERIFIED"
	if bad != 0 || seen != nodes || fin != 0 {
		verdict = "FAILED"
	}

	var digest uint64
	for w, r := range results {
		digest = digest*1099511628211 ^ r ^ uint64(w)
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stdout, "digest %016x\nworkers %d\ngc %s nodes %d finalized %d collections %d\n",
		digest, workers, verdict, seen, fin, collections)
	if verdict != "VERIFIED" {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
